requirements.text: 3+ years of experience building backend/cloud systems in production environments.
Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, APIs, and data modeling.
Experience with at least one modern backend language (e.g., Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, Java).
Comfortable owning services end-to-end: design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
Strong debugging skills; you can reason about failures across services, networks, and devices.
High agency and bias toward action in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
AI-native working style: you actively leverage AI tools to accelerate shipping and raise quality.
Nice-to-haves: IoT/device connectivity, event-driven architectures, time-series data, manufacturing systems, ERP/MES concepts.
